annotation.title_clean: Working Paper on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (Czechia)
annotation.title_en: Working Paper on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems (Czechia)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Czechia (CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN CCW GGE on LAWS, document CCW/GGE.1/2025/WP.5
named_instruments_referenced: Draft Articles on autonomous weapon systems (CCW)
annotation.summary_en: Czechia's national working paper to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS. It affirms IHL applies to autonomous weapons, insists on human responsibility and command and control, and favours non-binding measures such as codes of conduct. It supports the joint Draft Articles and Article 36 legal reviews.
key_provisions_or_claims: Existing IHL applies to all weapon systems, including those with autonomous functions.
Systems that cannot comply with IHL must not be developed or deployed; human responsibility cannot be transferred to machines.
Favours non-binding measures (codes of conduct, guidelines, political declarations) over a binding instrument.
Supports the joint Draft Articles on autonomous weapon systems as a basis for consensus.
Calls for lifecycle risk mitigation, bias minimisation, operator training and Article 36 legal reviews.
